nav.start_hint: The start date and the opening figures, step by step
start.intro: Set the day the app's records start, then enter what stood on that day, in this order. Each step opens the screen where its figures go; tick it done when they are all in.
start.step.shareholders: Shareholders: cash held and amounts owed
start.help.date: Opening figures are as of this day. It can't change once a month is closed or the opening stock is approved.
start.help.accounts: In Setup: money, the opening balance of each cash drawer, bank and bKash account.
start.help.shareholders: In Setup: money, what the business owed each shareholder and what they owed it; the shop's cash each one held is an account "Held by a shareholder" with its opening balance.
start.help.dues: In Setup: money, what each person owed the shop or the shop owed them.
start.help.suppliers: On Vendors and publishers, the opening due of each.
start.help.advances: In Payroll, each person's advance not yet repaid and pay still owed to them.
start.help.leave: In Leave, a change to each person's balance so it matches what they had left.
start.help.stock: Count the books on the shelves as an opening stock-take and send it; a shareholder who didn't count or send it approves it, like a delivery.
start.help.cafe: Count the café's stock once; later counts work out what was used from it.
start.count: {count, plural, =0 {None entered yet} one {# entered} other {# entered}}
home.opening_stock: The opening book stock waits for your approval
home.start_left: Getting started: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} left
sh.opening_owed_help: On the start date, before anything the app works out.
sh.opening_owes_help: On the start date, besides shop cash they hold and loans.
sh.opening_parts: Opening: owed to them {owed} · owed by them {owes}
take.opening_help: Copies on the shelves on {date}, the start date. It is sent for approval and done once.
take.opening_decide: Sent by {name}. Approving adds each title's copies to the stock, at the publisher's cost.
take.opening_waiting: Sent by {name}. A shareholder who didn't count or send it approves it.
take.send_body: Counts can't change while it waits. A shareholder who didn't count or send it approves it or sends it back.
val.start_date_first: Set the start date in Getting started first.
val.opening_done: The opening stock is already approved.
val.start_date_closed: A month is closed: the start date can't change.
val.start_date_stock: The opening stock is approved as of the start date: it can't change.
